reports.name: Monthly Release Detection Report
reports.description: Evidence of leak detection for tanks and piping via ATG static tests, interstitial monitoring, SIR, or approved method.
reports.trigger: Required for all active regulated UST systems

jurisdiction_notes.CO: Submit within Annual Compliance Package summary; keep 12 months on file. (OPS)
jurisdiction_notes.MT: Monthly walkthrough form must include release detection checks. (ARM 17.56)
jurisdiction_notes.AZ: Monthly LD plus plan/recordkeeping per ADEQ updates (2020).

reports.name: Monthly Walkthrough Inspection Checklist
reports.description: Visual inspection of spill buckets, fill pipes, release detection equipment; record anomalies.
reports.trigger: State-mandated in MT/CO; recommended/required elsewhere under EPA walk-through provisions adopted by states.

jurisdiction_notes.MT: Mandatory monthly; annual sump check also required. (ARM 17.56)
jurisdiction_notes.CO: Monthly compliance inspections recommended/recorded; reviewed annually.
jurisdiction_notes.ID: Triennial DEQ inspection will review walk-through records.

citations.MT: DEQ Rule Changes Brochure; July 2022 MUST News

reports.name: ATG Static Leak Test Result
reports.description: Static tank tightness test (e.g., 0.2 gph monthly or 0.1 gph as configured) from Veeder-Root ATG.
reports.trigger: If ATG is primary tank release detection method.

jurisdiction_notes.MT: Maintain last 12 months of passing ATG tests; annual ATG functionality test required.
jurisdiction_notes.CO: Provide test summaries in Annual Compliance Package.
jurisdiction_notes.ID/WY/AZ/NM/UT: Maintain monthly results for inspector review.

reports.name: Interstitial Monitoring Log
reports.description: 30-day check of double-walled tank/piping sensors or vacuum/brine levels.
reports.trigger: Required when secondary containment with interstitial monitoring is used.

jurisdiction_notes.MT: Record monthly sensor status and annual sensor operability test.
jurisdiction_notes.UT: New USTs require interstitial monitoring; report via approved forms.

reports.name: Pressurized Line Leak Detection Test
reports.description: Annual 3.0 gph test; optional 0.1/0.2 gph performance verification if applicable.
reports.trigger: Pressurized piping with electronic/mechanical leak detectors.

jurisdiction_notes.CO: ATG tapes must specify line tested and threshold; include in Annual Compliance Package.
jurisdiction_notes.MT: Single-wall pressurized lines require annual line tightness testing.
jurisdiction_notes.UT: Line leak detector functionality tests required for Certificate.

reports.name: Spill Bucket Tightness / Integrity Test
reports.description: Hydrostatic or vacuum integrity test for spill containment devices.
reports.trigger: Required under EPA revisions; adopted by states with local specifics.

jurisdiction_notes.MT: 3‑year tightness test; double-wall buckets may use 30‑day interstice logs in lieu of test.
jurisdiction_notes.AZ: Inspect at install and every 3 years thereafter.
jurisdiction_notes.UT: Report on Utah forms (PEI RP1200 references).

reports.name: Overfill Prevention Device Functionality Inspection
reports.description: Functional inspection of shutoff valves/alarms; ball float valves generally disallowed for replacements.

jurisdiction_notes.AZ: Initial test by 03/01/2020; 3‑year cycle thereafter; ball floats not acceptable for new/replacement.
jurisdiction_notes.CA_like_practice: (Reference style) Notify local agency before testing—varies by state.
jurisdiction_notes.ID/WY/MT/UT/CO/NM: Follow EPA cycle; state program may require specific forms.

reports.name: Containment/UDC Sump Integrity Test
reports.description: Integrity/tightness test of sumps used for interstitial monitoring or UDC.
reports.trigger: Where interstitial monitoring relies on sump containment.

jurisdiction_notes.UT: Annual tightness if sump sensor used as automatic line leak detector.
jurisdiction_notes.CO: Include in 3‑year compliance; annual visual checks documented.
jurisdiction_notes.MT: Annual sump check (visual) plus 3‑year integrity test where IM is primary.

reports.name: Cathodic Protection Test & Rectifier Readings
reports.description: CP system test results and periodic rectifier readings for impressed-current systems.

jurisdiction_notes.CO: 3‑year CP test results + rectifier logs (≥every two months) in Annual Compliance Package.
jurisdiction_notes.WY/ID/MT/AZ/NM/UT: Follow EPA criteria; retain tests and readings per state guidance.

reports.name: Annual ATG/Probe Functionality Test
reports.description: Verification that ATG/probes operate per manufacturer/EPA performance.
reports.trigger: All facilities using ATG for release detection.

jurisdiction_notes.MT: Explicitly required; maintain annual ATG functionality test reports.

citations.MT: DEQ Rule Changes Brochure; MUST News

reports.name: Release / Suspected Release Notification
reports.description: 24‑hour report to state when alarms, failed tests, product loss, liquids in interstice/sumps, or visual indicators suggest a release.

jurisdiction_notes.ID: Notify DEQ within 24 hrs; initial response actions required.
jurisdiction_notes.MT: ARM 17.56.502 requires 24‑hr reporting for specified conditions.

reports.name: Installation / Modification / Closure Notification
reports.description: Advance notice and post‑work documentation for new tanks, piping changes, closures.
reports.trigger: Install/modify/close USTs or switch to higher biofuel blends.

jurisdiction_notes.ID: 30‑day prior notice; 24 hr prior for certain piping; compatibility notice for >E10/>B20.
jurisdiction_notes.UT: Certificate of Compliance requires notifications, tests, as‑builts.
jurisdiction_notes.AZ: Plan review process; 30‑day biofuel compatibility notice.

reports.name: Operator Training & Authorization Records (A/B/C)
reports.description: Proof of Class A/B/C training, reauthorization cycles, and facility assignment.
reports.trigger: Designation changes, periodic reauthorization as required by state.

jurisdiction_notes.MT: Maintain A/B/C; verify prior to inspection.
jurisdiction_notes.NY_example: (Outside scope) 5‑year reauth; included for parity; states may vary.

citations.AZ: ADEQ Compliance (inspection review of operator records)

reports.name: Financial Responsibility / Trust Fund Enrollment
reports.description: Insurance/bond or state trust fund participation proving cleanup/third‑party coverage.
reports.trigger: Policy renewal, ownership change, or trust fund enrollment.

jurisdiction_notes.UT: Declare PST Fund or other mechanism when applying for Certificate.
jurisdiction_notes.WY: Financial responsibility account available per statute.

reports.name: Annual Compliance Package (Composite Submission)
reports.description: Aggregated submission of required annual summaries, tests, and inspections (state-specific).
reports.trigger: Required in CO; recommended elsewhere as best practice.

jurisdiction_notes.CO: Explicit package required; follow OPS checklist and documentation rules.
jurisdiction_notes.Others: Keep compiled annual dossier for inspector efficiency.

citations.CO: NISTM: Understanding the Colorado Annual Compliance Package
